name: Martín Fernández Roldán
headline: Senior Data Engineer
summary: Senior Data Engineer with 8 years of experience designing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and warehousing solutions across fintech and e-commerce sectors. Skilled in building ETL/ELT workflows, optimizing SQL performance, and orchestrating batch and streaming pipelines with Airflow. Experienced mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with data science and analytics teams to deliver reliable, production-grade data infrastructure.

responsibilities: Design and maintain Airflow DAGs orchestrating ingestion of financial transaction data from multiple sources
Lead migration of legacy batch jobs to a modern ELT architecture using dbt and Redshift
Optimize SQL queries and warehouse schemas to reduce reporting latency
Mentor two junior data engineers and review pull requests for pipeline code
Collaborate with data science team to provision curated datasets for ML models
Built and maintained ETL pipelines processing e-commerce transactional and clickstream data
Developed Airflow DAGs to automate daily ingestion and transformation jobs
Wrote optimized SQL queries and stored procedures for reporting dashboards
Implemented data quality checks and monitoring alerts for pipeline failures
Containerized data processing jobs using Docker for consistent deployment
Developed backend services in Python supporting internal reporting tools
Assisted in building initial data pipelines for extracting data from relational databases
Wrote SQL scripts for data extraction and transformation tasks
Supported production issues related to scheduled batch jobs

education.degree: Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación
